name: Ai no Katachi ~Ecchi na Onna no Ko wa Kirai... Desu ka?~
original_name: 愛のカタチ～エッチな女のコは嫌い…ですか？～
source:
Kunirou is living a busy life. One day, he meets a woman, Mayu who is ten years younger than he and he is gradually getting attracted to her. They have a physical relationship and the affairs are getting more bold to deepen their relationship....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
邦郎过着忙碌的生活。一天，他遇见比自己小十岁的女人真由，并逐渐被她吸引。两人发生了肉体关系，往来也变得越发大胆，彼此感情随之日益加深…
